Verification Summary Report — Pulse Generator

This report summarises the verification of the pulse generator (CMP-0001) and its parts. Its scope is the same query as any report about one component, reading the component from the report itself (^covers); its subcomponents follow from the component tree, so a part added to the pulse generator later is covered without editing this report.
